Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Name: The Black Throne
[LotN:R]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Assamite
Cost: 1 pool
Master: unique location.
Tap during a referendum to gain 2 votes. Tap when a minion with a contract leaves the ready region (only usable if an Assamite you control had been chosen for that contract) to gain 1 pool.
Artist: Mark Poole

Name: Shakar: the Hunt
[DM:C]
Cardtype: Master
Master: contract. Trifle. Unique. Requires a Black Hand vampire.
Put this card on a ready minion. Every Black Hand vampire is considered chosen for this contract. Any Black Hand vampire can enter combat with this minon as a +1 stealth  action. Burn this card when this minion leaves the ready region.
Artist: Javier Santos

You have two events in the same window. You get to order them the way you want. But if you burn the Contract first, you can't use the Black Throne.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
@Asnek:

If the conditions were met (a minion with a contract naming this Assamite, this Assamite was in combat with that minion and that minion is not ready) then you may play Provision of the Silsila at any later point in the action. If the contract is still in play, it is burned.

So the following is legal:

Dave has Shakar the Hunt on him. He ends up in combat with Nizzam al-Latif. Dave is no longer ready at the end of the contract. Nizzam's controller taps the Black Throne (1 pool), then plays Provision of the Silsila giving Nizzam enough blood to fill him to capacity and the Contract burns from the Provision.

@Drnlmza
It would follow normal sequencing.
Acting Meth, Blocking Meth, Other guys around the table in order.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Provisions is played after combat (it's not a combat card), while burning would likely happen during combat. But that doesn't change the answer: vekn.net/forum/6-rules-questions/60444-shakar--the-hunt-a-provision-of-the-silsila#60455 referring to  [LSJ 20010528]

Correct order to use all three cards:
- Selective Silence, Taste of Death on Lutz, hope for no Majesty.
- Use Black Throne to gain 1 pool
- Shakar the Hunt burns
- end of combat, Lutz is in torpor with no Contract.
- play Provision of the Silsila.
